fields.description: Issue includes extensive reporting of official vote totals for numerous Florida and local offices; editorial coverage of Coral Gables politics and finance centered on the controversy involving George E. Merrick and the city commission; commentary envisioning a larger “Greater Miami” and discussion of local sports promotion. Also includes an editorial letter regarding Merrick’s health and support, notice and advocacy for the East Coast Canal bond election (June 26) tied to inland waterway improvements to Biscayne Bay, society and humor columns, and local advertising and entertainment listings.
